note: D-PLY-63 (2026-11-11): ONE rule for which name of a cached channel is shown. `channel` is a row of channels.json, `position` its 1-based place among the rows, and `shown` EXACTLY what Model.displayName answers (the guide row, the bar) and what the helper's shown_name answers (the player's window title and media title after redaction, the stash, the play reply's name). tests/Model.test.js and tests/test_shown_name.py both run every case. Every host is under the reserved .test TLD and every credential is invented.

cases.why: an ordinary name is itself
the row's shape: a name of U+FEFF alone gives way to the tvg-name
a leading U+FEFF is not shown
a trailing U+FEFF is not shown
a dash behind a U+FEFF is dropped with it
a U+FEFF inside a name stays
a trailing dash stays
a URL-shaped name gives way to the tvg-name
a URL-shaped name with no tvg-name is the word and the position
a scheme with no slashes that the player reads
both URL-shaped: the word and the position
a URL-shaped tvg-name behind a U+FEFF name
a URL inside a name is still a name
a colon that follows no scheme the rule names
the KELVIN SIGN is no ASCII letter, so this is no scheme
LATIN SMALL LETTER LONG S is no ASCII letter
mms behind a long s is no mms
U+0085 and U+001F at the edges are taken
only dashes and spaces: the tvg-name
no name at all and no position
an empty tvg-name
